name: nullrouter-dashboard-styles
description: Stylesheet build for the dashboard. Not part of the Rust build; the output it produces is committed.

comments.oxide: npm has a long-standing bug where a platform-specific optional dependency is skipped (npm/cli#4828), which makes @tailwindcss/cli fail with 'Cannot find native binding'. If that happens, install the binding for your platform explicitly, e.g. npm install @tailwindcss/oxide-linux-x64-gnu@4.3.3.
comments.node: Tailwind 4 declares node >= 20 and warns on 18, but runs correctly there.
